target_customer: Mid-size and large companies in Latin America (HR and L&D leaders)
problem: Companies in Latam lack integrated tools to set goals, evaluate performance and train employees, including remote teams.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus content and talent services

founders.name: Santiago Maldonado
founders.background_notes: Described on YC as a tech enthusiast helping mid-size Latam companies close the gap between goals and learning.

founders.name: Pedro Sors
founders.background_notes: Named in an interview profile (foundations.axented.com), not on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard HR SaaS: goals, evaluations, course delivery.

defensibility.rationale: Employee data and integrated learning content create some stickiness, but features are common among HR suites.

market_need_then: Remote work in 2020-2021 increased demand for distributed workforce development; the company pitched itself as Lattice for Latam. No quantitative demand source found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, optimistic, people-centered; tagline 'It's the people'

rebrands.why: Not stated; date unknown (Expansion article Dec 2022 calls lapzo the evolution unifying development and performance)

brand_strength.rationale: Named customers (Banamex, Nestle, OXXO) show reach but no sources on brand pull; rebrand from Lernit shows the original name was outgrown.

pivots.to: lapzo (unified learning, performance and talent platform)
pivots.why: Not stated; sourced to Expansion Dec 2022 and an interview profile

outcome_analysis: lapzo (formerly Lernit) is a Monterrey HR and learning platform founded in 2018 that joined YC in Summer 2021 and still operates, with enterprise customers such as Banamex, Nestle and OXXO shown on its site. Funding is poorly documented, with aggregators suggesting under $1M total, so how well it has grown cannot be judged beyond a large reported team of about 135.
notes: Rounds added from single databases: Seedtable 125K seed 2021-09 (three unnamed investors) and CB Insights 0.4M seed 2024-10 (VCBacked dates a seed 2024-10-01 with BDev Ventures, Plug and Play, Dragon Capital, Soma Capital, DVC listed, not attributed to a round here). CB Insights total is 900K over 3 rounds, so one round is missing; Briter says 300K, Caplight 4.08M, geo.sig.ai 800K and 17.3M revenue (implausible, ignored); not summed. Team size 135 on YC vs about 118 elsewhere. Headquarters Monterrey vs San Pedro. No dated competitors near mid-2021 found. Name origin not found. Pedro Sors from one interview profile only; Crunchbase and a second source also name him co-founder of lapzo (formerly Lernit).
